title: Shining Force III Premium Disc
native_title: シャイニング・フォースⅢ プレミアム・ディスク
overview:
Shining Force III Premium Disc is a not-for-sale bonus disc for players who completed the Shining Force III trilogy of scenarios. It collects extras from the simulation RPG series.

- Character model viewer for the game's heroes and monsters
- Illustrations and concept art
- Movies and a sound test
- Special bonus battles that use save data from the three scenario discs
